prereq.p: Support the rotor before releasing bearing retainers.

step.cmd: Record the as-found radial play and bearing identification.
Drain the carrier and withdraw the supported rotor.
Remove both bearings with a puller.
Fit new bearings and spacer in the order shown in Figure 10-4.
Fill the carrier with 0.75 L ISO VG 68 PAO oil.
Measure installed radial play and complete the functional test.
